chapter: Armstrong, Big Sid and Joe Glaser
title: Dicky Wells working Louis for $25 above the Turf in New York
summary: Bigard overheard Dicky Wells boast to a friend that he would show him how to get money, then win $25 from Louis with a sad story.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So when we came back to New York and we was playing upstairs where the old Bop City, I think it was --

Yeah. Over the -- right. And Dicky Wells brought a friend and he's telling -- and I heard him -- Louie had his dressing room. He's telling his friend, "I'll show you how to get money, man. Watch. Watch me." And he'd go in there and he puts a sad story on Louie and he thinks Louie is falling for it because Louie said, "Hey, man, take this," and gave him $25. He said, "You go ahead and help yourself."

So he came out there and he's looking at the guy and giving him a big wink and said -- like as if to say, "You see? I told you I was going to 'get it.'" And they did all kind of things like that to Louie, but he didn't care.
